title: You can now send CNY to China with Grey
summary: Grey lets you send CNY to bank accounts across China. Learn about transfer fees, sending limits, processing times and supported balances.
body_markdown:
Your Grey balance just got a new destination.[Send CNY directly to personal and business bank accounts](https://grey.co/money-transfer/china) in China using the USD, EUR, GBP, or stablecoins you already have in Grey.


We will handle the conversion, and you’ll see all the details before you send.


Here’s what you need to know before making your first transfer.


## Send CNY directly to Chinese bank accounts


With the new CNY transfer option, you can send money straight to your recipient’s bank account in China.


Bank transfers are available for both personal and business accounts across operating banks in the country. So, you can use Grey to send money to friends and family, pay for services, or make payments to businesses in China.


And because you can send from a balance you already have in Grey, there’s no need to convert your money to CNY somewhere else first.


## How much does it cost to send CNY with Grey?


Each CNY bank transfer costs a flat $2.80.


There’s no percentage-based transfer fee, so the cost stays the same regardless of how much you send within the available limits.


Before you confirm your transfer, you’ll see the exchange rate, fee and how much your recipient will get. This way, you know exactly what to expect before the money leaves your account.


## How much CNY can you send?


You can send from 50 CNY up to 21,000 CNY in a single bank transfer.


It's enough flexibility for everything from paying a contractor to sending money to someone back home. How long does it take to send CNY to China?


CNY bank transfers are typically completed within 24 hours, Monday to Friday.


There’s a 10:00 GMT cutoff time, so keep this in mind if you need your money to arrive by a particular day. Transfers made after the cutoff may take longer to reach the recipient.


Processing times can also vary depending on banking days and other factors outside Grey’s control.


## Which Grey balances can you send from?


You don’t need to hold CNY before sending money to China.


You can make your transfer using money from your USD, EUR, GBP or stablecoin balance.


Choose the balance you want to use, enter the amount you’d like your recipient to get in CNY and review the conversion before confirming.


It’s a simple way to use money you already have in Grey to send money to China.


## How to send CNY to China with Grey


Sending CNY takes just a few steps:


1. Log in to your Grey account and go to Send money.
2. Select CNY as the currency you want to send.
3. Choose bank transfer.
4. Add your recipient’s bank details and the amount you want to send.
5. Choose the Grey balance you want to send from.
6. Review the exchange rate, fees, and the amount your recipient will receive.
7. Confirm your transfer.


Once everything looks right, confirm your transfer, and Grey will take it from there.


## Send money to China from your Grey account


Your Grey balance can now take you one country further.


You can send CNY directly to Chinese suppliers, contractors, and partners in China from your USD, EUR, GBP, or stablecoin balance, at a flat $2.80 transfer fee. If you live and work outside China, you can also use CNY payouts to send money directly to family and friends in China.


So the next time you need to send money to China, you can do it while keeping your money and your payments in one place.


Open Grey and[make your first CNY transfer](https://grey.co/money-transfer/china) today.
